Platform

A cashier rail, not a one-off feature.

The Haus is positioned as infrastructure for products that want smoother spending, cleaner settlement, and a stronger user-facing flow on Avalanche. It is meant to sit underneath the experience and make the product feel better, faster, and easier to use.

W

Wallet backbone

Start from wallet-backed ownership and signed authorization, then build a product flow that feels more premium than repeated wallet popups.

S

Smarter spend layer

Hold usable balances inside the application flow so users can act, play, spend, and move faster once they are in the system.

M

Modular by design

Payments, rewards, game loops, treasury actions, community tools, and social extensions can all operate from the same rail.

Experience

Built to feel like a product, not a crypto chore.

What The Haus changes

Most web3 products still push every repeated action back through the wallet. That slows users down, breaks momentum, and makes the experience feel heavier than it should.

Connect value to a structured cashier system
Let the application handle faster balance-backed flows
Bring payouts, rewards, and withdrawals back through the same rail
Support premium UX without abandoning web3 trust anchors

Who this is for

The Haus fits products that need more than a connect-wallet button. Games, monetized apps, communities, team tools, reward systems, and social products all benefit when spend becomes easier and repeat actions stop feeling expensive.

Flows

One value rail. Multiple product surfaces.

01 · Wallet-first

For web3-native users

Start with wallet connection, signed authorization, and a clean spend path that respects ownership without making every click feel like a transaction ceremony.

02 · Easier access

For broader user adoption

Add simpler access flows and still tie users into the same cashier logic, giving products a friendlier entry point without splitting the balance model.

03 · Extend outward

For communities and social layers

Push the cashier system beyond the web app into bots, alerts, admin actions, gifting, rewards, and community-facing experiences.
